title: Portability is profile addition, not profile renaming
summary: v0.6 qualifies Linux x86-64 little-endian LP64 only. ABI-native scalars reduce unnecessary fixed-width assumptions, but they do not authorize claiming AArch64 or another Unix family without independent aggregate and semantic evidence.
invariants: The current concrete profile is linux-x86_64-le-lp64.
AArch64, BSD, macOS or another Unix target requires its own constants/layout evidence and may require semantic feature gating.
Linux-only facilities such as abstract sockets, SO_PEERCRED/SCM_CREDENTIALS, accept4 flags and /proc inode mutation helpers must not be silently advertised as portable POSIX semantics.
Portability claims are narrower than successful compilation on one host.
procedure: For each new target, qualify Foreign Runtime ABI support first, then author and force a matching Unix Socket bridge/profile and gate OS-specific semantics explicitly.

provenance.claim: Qualification narrows the concrete portability claim to linux-x86_64-le-lp64 and rejects copying layouts to other Unix ABIs.
